name: direct_method_supplier_cash_with_advances_and_share_settlem_pair
question_template: A retailer prepares its operating cash flows by the direct method. Cost of goods sold for the year is {COGS} USD and contains no write-downs; all inventory is bought on credit from trade suppliers, and trade payables relate only to those suppliers. Inventory is {INV_OPEN} USD at the start of the year and {INV_CLOSE} USD at the end. Trade payables are {AP_OPEN} USD at the start and {AP_CLOSE} USD at the end. Supplier advances (cash prepaid to suppliers, later drawn down against purchases) are {ADV_OPEN} USD at the start and {ADV_CLOSE} USD at the end; cash paid as advances counts as cash paid to suppliers. During the year, {SHARE_SETTLE} USD of trade payables was settled in cash raised by issuing the retailer's own shares, so it counts as cash paid to suppliers. Define net supplier working capital as inventory plus supplier advances minus trade payables, and its change as the closing balance minus the opening balance, so a positive change means working capital grew and absorbed cash. Determine the inventory purchases for the year, the change in trade payables (closing minus opening), the signed change in net supplier working capital, and the cash paid to suppliers expressed as a positive outflow magnitude. If the implied cash paid is negative, treat the data as inconsistent.

slots.description: Inventory purchases for the year derived from cost of goods sold and inventory balances
Change in trade payables, closing minus opening, signed
Signed change in net supplier working capital, positive when cash is absorbed

program:
def solve():
    cogs = Q(P["COGS"])
    inv_open = Q(P["INV_OPEN"])
    inv_close = Q(P["INV_CLOSE"])
    ap_open = Q(P["AP_OPEN"])
    ap_close = Q(P["AP_CLOSE"])
    adv_open = Q(P["ADV_OPEN"])
    adv_close = Q(P["ADV_CLOSE"])
    share_settle = Q(P["SHARE_SETTLE"])

    purchases = cogs + inv_close - inv_open
    payables_change = ap_close - ap_open
    advances_change = adv_close - adv_open
    inventory_change = inv_close - inv_open
    net_wc_change = inventory_change + advances_change - payables_change

    # settlement funded by cash from the share issue is a cash payment to suppliers, so it is not deducted
    cash_paid = purchases - payables_change + advances_change
    if cash_paid < 0:
        raise ValueError("implied cash paid to suppliers is negative; data inconsistent")

    return {
        "final": cash_paid,
        "purchases": purchases,
        "payables_change": payables_change,
        "net_wc_change": net_wc_change
    }
